_comment: Death Guard army rule citations (10e). Iter 15: removed the fabricated `simulator.disgustingly_resilient` army-wide FNP 5+ entry — there is NO codex-level Feel No Pain in the 10e Death Guard codex per Wahapedia + Goonhammer 'Hammer of Math: New Disgustingly Resilient' + Goonhammer codex review. The Disgustingly Resilient rule is ONLY the 2 CP Virulent Vectorium stratagem (-1 damage per allocated attack, INFANTRY/CHARACTER scope) cited separately under `Stratagem.Disgustingly Resilient` in stratagems.json. Per-datasheet innate FNP (Plague Marines fnp=5, Mortarion fnp=5, Deathshroud fnp=4, etc.) is carried on profile.fnp via overrides.json / parsed.json and is honoured by Unit.receive_damage. Contagions of Nurgle / Nurgle's Gift — the 3" aura that debuffs enemy units near any DG model. Iter-4 dropped the legacy R1 -1 T branch (launch-index Virulent Rot, no longer in the 10e codex); the remaining shape is -1 Ld R2 (Maladictive Pall, ~ Rattlejoint Ague direction) and -1 to hit R3+ (Fulminating Plague, ~ Scabrous Soulrot direction). Radius 3" matches the modern Nurgle's Gift / Afflicted rule. Worldblight — Virulent Vectorium detachment passive (sticky DG objectives + Nurgle's Gift on locked objectives, APPROXIMATED to sticky-control only).

VIRULENT_VECTORIUM.worldblight_sticky_dg.quoted_text: If you control an objective marker at the end of your Command phase and a DEATH GUARD unit from your army (excluding Battle-shocked units) is within range of that objective marker, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Nurgle's Gift ability as if it were a DEATH GUARD model from your army.
VIRULENT_VECTORIUM.worldblight_sticky_dg.trigger: end of own Command phase, with a non-Battle-shocked DG unit in range of a controlled objective marker
VIRULENT_VECTORIUM.worldblight_sticky_dg.effect: approximation: only the sticky-control half is modelled — at the end of each Command phase the simulator's objective-scoring path treats DG-controlled objectives the same way as the `sticky_objective` profile flag (locks until the opponent outscores the DG army on it at end of phase). The 'objective gains Nurgle's Gift' half is dropped (we don't model objective markers as aura sources, so the contagion-on-objective effect has no consumer). Composes naturally with the existing `_sticky_owner` book-keeping in Battle._init

simulator.contagions_of_nurgle.quoted_text: Each model in your army has the following aura ability: 'Aura: While an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of this model, that enemy unit is Afflicted'. CONTAGION RANGE: 1st Battle Round: Contagion Range = 3"; 2nd Battle Round: Contagion Range = 6"; 3rd Battle Round Onwards: Contagion Range = 9". Modern 10e applies named Afflictions (Skullsquirm Blight / Rattlejoint Ague / Scabrous Soulrot) to each Afflicted enemy unit. Older index/launch shape escalated by round: Round 1 - Virulent Rot (-1 T); Round 2 - Maladictive Pall (-1 Ld); Round 3+ - Fulminating Plague (-1 to hit).
simulator.contagions_of_nurgle.trigger: an enemy unit is within the round's Contagion Range of any DEATH GUARD model on the opposing side at the moment the relevant roll is taken
simulator.contagions_of_nurgle.effect: DURA-AUDIT-D1 (docs/_DURA_AUDIT_D_DEATHGUARD.md divergence D1): the Contagion Range now escalates 3"/6"/9" by battle round exactly per the printed schedule, via `_contagion_range_for_round` in code/units.py (env-gated SWEG_DG_CONTAGION_ESCALATION, default ON; '0' restores the pre-fix fixed 3" radius every round). Every caller of `_is_near_enemy_dg_model` -- the Unit.attack hit-roll debuff, the three Battle-shock contagion_sources/contagion_range sites in code/simulator.py, and the Creeping Blight Afflicted-target check -- now derives its radius from this helper instead of hard-coding 3.0. The launch-index Round-1 -1 T (Virulent Rot) branch in code/units.py was removed in iter-4 -- it had no modern-codex anchor. Pending the chosen-Plague fix (docs/_DURA_AUDIT_D_DEATHGUARD.md divergence D3), SwegHammer still applies a rule-conservative round-staggered mix (R2 -1 Ld ~ Rattlejoint/Scabrous direction, R3+ -1 to hit ~ Skullsquirm direction) rather than one PLAYER-chosen Plague active from round 1 -- see `simulator.dg_chosen_plague` for the real chosen-Plague mechanic and `simulator.dg_afflicted_toughness` for the always-on Afflicted -1 Toughness. DG units themselves are excluded (the aura debuffs *enemy* units only).

simulator.dg_tank_hunters.quoted_text: In your Shooting phase, each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a Monster or Vehicle unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
simulator.dg_tank_hunters.trigger: SWEG_DG_TANK_HUNTERS default-on ('0' is the byte-identical kill-switch); a ranged attack (mode != 'melee', matching 'In your Shooting phase') by the Myphitic Blight-hauler (p.faction == 'Death Guard' and p.name == 'Myphitic Blight-hauler', per-weapon profile inside the multi-weapon firing loop, safe under per-model promotion) against a target carrying the MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword
simulator.dg_tank_hunters.effect: The qualifying ranged attack gains +1 to the Hit roll AND +1 to the Wound roll: Unit.attack adds 1 to both hit_mod_delta and wound_mod_delta (each independently subject to the standard +-1 10e modifier cap, so this composes correctly with any other hit/wound modifier already in play rather than stacking past +1). BSData source: Chaos - Death Guard.cat.gz inline Abilities profile id e47-254c-cdf9-7c5e (verified verbatim; unique to the Blight-hauler among Death Guard datasheets — no other Death Guard unit carries this ability). Durability fidelity wave, audit B fix 2: this ability sits on the ATTACKING side but is durability-relevant in the audited direction — omitting it inflated the apparent durability of any Monster/Vehicle brick (an Imperial/Chaos Knight, another army's superheavy) on the receiving end of Blight-hauler shooting, and under-credited Death Guard's own brick-cracking toolkit. Off path (SWEG_DG_TANK_HUNTERS=0) leaves hit_mod_delta/wound_mod_delta unchanged — byte-identical.
